stage: S2 source preparation only; not closure of S1 transfer or adoption
source_version: ADS Roman rural settlement archive,2015 updated2018, collection1352
known_before_plan: Public introduction/download list plus database DDL metadata and major/minor classification lookups inspected. No core/site/association/role observation table loaded. Published approx3600 records describe approx2500 settlements, not a full census. Exact encoded public download links work; guessed unencoded paths return403.
access: Research preparation using official archive URLs and reviewed ADS Terms of Use and Access. Cache original CSVs locally, retain citations/URLs/SHA256; do not redistribute raw source tables. Locally computed hashes are not independently published source checksums.

checks.identity: Audit source record ID/primary-key uniqueness and joins; major/minor role rows reference site-data ID, association records reference core-data ID. Do not claim core IDs are unique physical settlements, or merge records by nearest location or an unverified shared project identifier.
checks.coordinates: X_REF/Y_REF are source-documented OSGB easting/northing text fields. Retain leading zero/format evidence; report missing/non-numeric/length/plausibility counts without automatic projection, lat/lon guessing or target maps.
checks.time: DATE_START/DATE_END have negative BC values. Report missing/inverted/zero-valued dates and apparent interval compatibility with AD200 separately. Broad span compatibility does not establish continuous or precisely dated occupation; unknown is not absent or always active.
checks.roles: Keep simultaneous major/minor categories by source-record ID; audit unknown labels, duplicates and orphan rows. Farms/villas/villages/towns/forts/religious/industrial/route observations are not all administrative centres or independent authority sources.
checks.size: AREA measures investigated/excavated hectares, not full settlement or urban area. SETTLEMENT_SIZE is a separate source wordlist; inspect completeness/distinct bins but do not convert to population or treat graphic markers as measured extents.
checks.coverage: Retain region/fieldwork metadata and multi-record/association patterns. This is excavation-selected Britain overlapping the existing Roman development geography, not complete site counts or automatically independent/global transfer evidence.

forbidden: No climate lookup, candidate fitting, validation score, coordinate map, population/control update, actor assignment from role or geography, or automatic sealed status. No de facto source can be created from a record count alone.
output: Aggregate schema/join/date/role/coverage audit and source identities, with no individual coordinates/site rows; decide preparation readiness for separately declared S2 role-specific calibration. All S1c/S1d/S1e and S3–S5 work remains open.
